k:rp-tie-calibration-outcome@1.0:053fe48.excerpt:
[PRIOR RECORD (follow_up; decision_status: reported; execution_status: calibration_completed; outcome_status: improved_in_sample) - history, not a standing rule.]
## TL assessment
Agreement increased from two to seven of these eight pairs. RP14-C08 remained disputed because the packet did not establish whether an output-format constraint was mandatory; that pair was retained for confirmation.

## Limit
This supports a limited calibration benefit in the reviewed sample. It does not establish independent accuracy, eliminate future disagreements, or define a universal accuracy-versus-format preference rule. A new batch needs its own evidence.

k:response-preference-instructions@1.1:a.excerpt:
## Content-quality rubric
Major/minor describe task-quality defects and do not determine operational incident severity.

| Dimension | Major defect | Minor defect | Acceptable / no automatic penalty |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Factual accuracy | Error changes the central conclusion or actionable answer | Nonessential background error without that effect | Accurate paraphrase or an immaterial stylistic difference |
| Instruction adherence | Explicit required format/structure is missing | Limited violation of an actual secondary requirement | A stylistic choice that violates no requirement |
| Citation support | Fabricated reference or materially unsupported attribution | A limited citation-detail error where the source and support remain identifiable | A valid source that supports the claim |
| Preference | Identify a meaningful benefit; grade underlying defects separately | Do not manufacture a defect to break a tie | No meaningful quality difference supports a tie |

An inaccessible link needs a verification note; lack of access alone does not establish the error grade of the claim.

## Current recorded state
The handoff occurred and the incident remained open at 17:00 UTC. No fix or successful submission was recorded. New task reports must be matched to the symptoms before linking them to this incident; a similar button state does not establish the same cause.

k:response-preference-instructions@1.1:3.excerpt:
## Factual errors and citations
- A factual error is major when it changes the central conclusion or the answer a user would act on.
- A nonessential background error with no effect on that conclusion is minor.
- A broken link is an access/verification failure, not proof that the underlying factual claim is false.
- Distinguish an existing source that does not support the claim from an invented reference.

k:rp-tie-calibration-post@1.0:4a3c786f.excerpt:
[ANNOUNCEMENT posted 2026-09-16T14:00:00Z by TEAM_LEAD (rp_batch_14): not established as handling for this topic until you show it is relevant and gives a directive.]
Preference batch 14 calibration: choose a tie when neither answer offers a meaningful quality advantage. If choosing A or B, identify the user-facing benefit rather than saying only that it sounds nicer. Keep material factual or instruction-following defects separate. Bring both rationales for disputed pairs to the eight-pair calibration review. This message clarifies the existing criterion; it does not create a new numerical threshold.
